title: Woonbeeldenonderzoek Amsterdam 1982
descriptions: Housing conditions / motives to move / efforts made to find a more appropriate house / propensity to accept c.q. refuse various types of houses distributed by the municipality of Amsterdam or housing associations / photographs of the houses were shown to respondent, stating the qualities of the houses, floor area, rent, costs of heating, neighbourhood, waiting period / motives to accept c.q. refuse. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets
